title: Differential pulse voltametric detection of dopamine using polyaniline-functionalized graphene oxide/silica nanocomposite for point-of-care diagnostics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15870-15878
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00714C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ankita Tejwani, Urvashi Sonkar, Kamlesh Shrivas, Khushali Tandey, Indrapal Karbhal, Manas Kanti Deb, Shamsh Pervez
In this study, a novel composite material, GO/SiO2@PANI, was synthesized and employed as an electrochemical sensor for the detection of dopamine in urine using differential pulse voltammetry (DPV).
